Last week's AirPods Pro 3 deal at nearly 25% off is still live, but likely won't last long, we also spotted the matte black Beats Solo Buds dropping as low as $41. And headlining today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break is Apple's official refurbished store launching the lowest-price M5 MacBook Pro with $300 off, the new Apple Watch Series 11 models with $100 off, plus rare discounts on Apple Sport Bands and Loops. We'll then be taking you through the all-time low prices on Anker's newest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand and the 45W Nano smart display charger, along with Best Buy's updated Back to School promotions. See below for all the details.

Amazon's near 25% off deal on AirPods Pro 3 is still live, with prices potentially going back up at any time

Last week's Apple Shopping Event brought us one of the best AirPods Pro 3 deals we've seen so far. The Best Buy side of that deal alongside the Pro 3 discounts there have ended, pivoting instead to refresh its 2026 Back to School promotions, but Amazon's near 25% off AirPods Pro 3 deal is still live...for now.

Amazon is still selling Apple's latest AirPods Pro 3 for $189.99 with free shipping.

That's nearly 25% off the $249 list price, around $10 below July's Black Friday deal, and one of the lowest prices we've tracked since launch.

Best Buy's price had already risen back up to $200 early this morning. Recent patterns typically foreshadow Amazon's pricing trajectory, meaning the extra savings you find at Amazon could end at any time — if you want them this week, now is the time to lock in the deal. It wouldn't be surprising at all to see Amazon adjust its price back up to match Best Buy's at some point this morning.

We've only seen two instances of a lower price than this current deal, and they were fleeting discounts — one back in February for $184, and another more recently during the June Prime Day sale. Both deals have long since ended, and it's likely you'll have to wait until the fall sale season to see prices get this good again, especially as Apple could be releasing next-gen models next month with possibly a camera in tow and an even higher price tag.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $119 (Reg. $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Apple's official refurbished store launches lowest-price M5 MacBook Pro with $300 off

While we're still tracking the $500 price drop on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, the lowest-priced model in the M5 lineup has been tough to find discounted. But the Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering an attractive deal on the cheapest M5 MacBook Pro still available — specifically the model equipped with 16GB/1TB, $300 off the original price.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now selling the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro equipped with 16GB RAM and 1TB SSD for $1,699 with free shipping.

Originally priced at $1,999, you can now get it directly from the manufacturer, complete with a full 1-year Apple warranty, for $300 less than a new unit.

For comparison and further context, Amazon is currently selling this model new for $1,849. And it's stayed at or above this price on Amazon since official retailer price increases took effect at the end of June.

Although this is a refurbished unit, we're talking about the most reliable source for buying refurbished MacBooks, and among the lowest prices you can find online from reputable sources for an Apple-still-sold M5 MacBook Pro.

Anker's newest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand is back at its Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

Having had the chance to review this model when it launched earlier this year, Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a staple in my EDC, travel bag, and home charging setup. Now at nearly 35% off, we have another chance to grab it at the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon.

Anker's official Amazon store is now selling the latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 with free shipping.

Originally priced at $150, this charger features 3-in-1 functionality, with the MagSafe charging pad providing up to 25W output, and both the Phantom Black and Bright White colorways are available at nearly 35% off.

This week's deal matches the one we mentioned previously, aligning with Anker's Summer Blowout sale discounts and this year's Prime Day prices.

Although it's a palm-sized, portable device, it has some heft to it that allows it to sit securely on your desk or nightstand, performing equally well in your home workspace or out and about.

You can use the main MagSafe charging pad while it's folded up, but when you unfold it to pop out the Apple Watch charger and third Qi charging pad for your AirPods, it can charge your entire device setup.

  • 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger with 25W Qi2
  • Active cooling 'cicada wing' bionic airflow channels for 'whisper-quiet 19dB operation'
  • 25W total output across three devices: iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods
  • Qi2 certified with MagSafe-compatible magnetic alignment • Supports iPhone 17, 16, 15, and 14 series
  • iPhone: Up to 25W wireless charging
  • (3.74 × 2.38 × 1.22 inches), weighs the same as iPhone 17 Pro Max (8.11 oz)
  • What's in the box: Anker Prime Wireless Charging Station (3-in-1, MagGo, AirCool, foldable), 45W USB-C charger, 5ft USB-C to USB-C cable, 2 anti-slip phone stickers, welcome guide, 24-month warranty

Check out my unboxing review here for more details.

Lowest-price Apple Watch Series 11 models drop another $100 starting from $299

Amazon brings its AirPods Pro 3 summer discounts into August, along with all-time low prices on AirTag 2, and once again offers $100 off most of the most popular (and most affordable) Apple Watch Series 11 models, starting from $299.

Amazon is once again offering all base GPS Apple Watch Series 11 models $100 off the regular price, with the 42mm model at $299 and the 46mm at $329.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

These match the deals we tracked during summer Prime Day, and have resurfaced at various points in July, with another chance to grab them today. At the time of writing, only the base GPS versions have meaningful discounts — the GPS + Cellular versions have some deals, but generally haven't dropped low enough to be worth picking up.

It looks like the base 42mm Jet Black is out of stock at Amazon right now, but it likely won't stay that way for long — all 46mm color options are in stock and down by $100 each.

Amazon's rare sale this week knocks 20% off Apple Sport Bands and Loops

Today's matte black Beats Solo Buds deal drops as low as $41

Best Buy updates 2026 Back to School sale: sub-$500 TVs, $130 off Bose, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen, and more

Anker 2026 Back to School sale drops chargers, power banks, and Qi2.2 gear to Prime Day lows from $10 (46% off)

Anker is now running a Back to School promotion covering its entire accessory lineup, with promo code SCHOOL20 offering 20% off site-wide, including chargers, power banks, cables, charging stations, and more. The brand's official Amazon store is also joining in with many deals, simultaneously offering extra discounts on select popular models. From small Nano chargers to multi-port laptop chargers, and MagSafe charging products, power banks, and other everyday accessories, there are deals to be had. Many Amazon deals are bringing prices back down to the all-time lows we tracked during the recent Prime Day period, giving you a chance to grab them at the best price ever without waiting for the next big shopping holiday. If you're setting up a new school or work setup, or need to update your charging gear, there are plenty of Anker deals worth checking out right now.

Anker 2026 Back to School sale officially kicks off

The brand's official Amazon store has joined in with multiple new deals, which we've flagged below, along with a list of some existing deals for your reference.

  • Anker 45W Nano with smart display charger $26 (Reg. $40)
  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging station with display $135 (Reg. $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch controls $116 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker 140W 4-port laptop charger with display $65 (Reg. $90)
  • Anker 25,000mAh 165W laptop power bank with dual USB-C cables $105 (Reg. $120)
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 docking station with detachable 6-in-1 hub $112 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 charging station $72 (Reg. $90)
  • Anker Nano ultra-slim 5,000mAh MagSafe power bank $44 (Reg. $55)
  • Promo code: SCHOOL20
  • And much more...

One standout deal from this sale is Anker's newest 45W Nano USB-C charger with smart display, back down to $25.99 with free shipping. Originally priced at $40, today's deal takes $16 off, matching the all-time low from the recent Prime Day. That's 35% off, and even lower than the deals we tracked on Anker's official site. This is one of Anker's newer compact chargers, with all existing color options also available at the same low price of $25.99. The built-in smart display can identify supported iPhone models, optimize charging for safer power delivery, and display useful charging information along with a few fun animations. It delivers up to 45W output through a single USB-C port, and the foldable prongs keep the whole unit compact for travel, tech bags, or everyday carry.
